text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for SERVICE: model-serving-prod (us-west-2) — spike in 5xx errors (p50 latency OK, error rate 18% over 2m). Pager: pg/INC-2026-345

sre-bot: Created incident INC-2026-345 · severity P1 · incident doc: https://infra.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-345 · channel #eng-oncall

Anya Patel: I'm primary oncall, taking this. Assigning Mike as secondary.

Michael Chen: @Anya I'm on it — standing by. What do we see in the tracing?

Anya Patel: Traces show errors originate in model-infer-roup (kv cache hits dropping). Also a few nodes reporting OOM-ish failures in logs. Quick plan: 1) route traffic off the suspect model variant to fallback, 2) scale replicas temporarily, 3) restart the offending pod group, 4) clear model KV prefix if necessary.

Devon Reyes: +1. Quick commands I usually use:
```bash
# scale up model-serving deployment by 2 replicas
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-serving --replicas=8

# restart the node pool responsible for heavy KV churn (named node-17)
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/model-serving-node-17
```

oncall-ops-bot: Runbook pointer: model-serving-5xx-playbook · https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/model-serving-5xx-playbook · Quick steps at top.

Anya Patel: I'm going to flip routing to fallback variant now (console toggle). Notifying infra to scale replicas.

Jess Liu: If you flip routing, also enable short-circuit cache TTL to prevent repeated cold misses: set `KV_CACHE_TTL=30s` for the job that loads prefixes. That helped last time.

Michael Chen: I'm patching the rollout to fallback variant and increasing replica count. Pasting the API call I used earlier: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/rollouts 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"open-m-3","version":"2026-02-01","policy":"immediate"}'
```

Anya Patel: Done — traffic now routed 100% to fallback model-version 2026-02-01.

sre-bot: INC-2026-345 update: mitigation applied — fallback routed, replica count bumped to 8, restart issued to node-17. Monitoring for 5xx regression.

Michael Chen: Metrics: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 4% in 90s. p95 latency stable. https://metrics.redwood.com/dashboards/serving/errors?inc=2257801234

Devon Reyes: If we still see intermittent errors, we should trigger KV cache eviction for the affected prefix: `redis-cli -h kv-cache-prod del key:prefix:model-infer-*`. Use caution (briefly increases load).

Anya Patel: Logging a temporary alert suppression for noisy OOM alerts so we don't get paged while we're healing: placed a 30m mute on rule `serve.node.oom` in PagerDuty.

Jess Liu: Leaving a quick checklist for whoever takes postmortem: 1) verify root cause (OOM vs model load), 2) confirm KV cache strategy (TTL/eviction), 3) assess why node-17 had memory pressure, 4) add canary routing for new model variants.

Anya Patel: Handoff note: I'll remain primary for next 45m to confirm stability, Mike will be secondary and take over if I need to escalate. Devon — can you file a follow-up ticket to investigate node memory scheduling? Tagging @Devon.

Devon Reyes: Filing now: TICKET-1789 — investigate model-serving node memory blowouts and recommend scheduler changes. Linking incident doc.

sre-bot: INC-2026-345 mitigation status: monitored for 15m post-mitigation — error rate stable under 5%. Recommended next step: keep fallback until patch rollout complete.

Anya Patel: Adding notes to the incident doc and to the runbook: quick-mitigation steps executed are in the first section (scale -> route -> restart -> optional kv-evict).

Michael Chen: Confirming: I'll keep a dashboard watch for the next 60m and escalate if error rate >7% for 3 consecutive minutes.

oncall-ops-bot: Full runbook link for post-incident checklist: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/model-serving-post-incident-checklist · also add runbook edit for circuit-breaker defaults.

Anya Patel: OK wrapping the immediate thread — leaving final state in incident doc and moving to postmortem draft after stability window. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Jess Liu: Adding one-line remediation template for fast future reference: "flip to fallback model -> bump replicas -> restart suspect pods -> evict KV prefix (if cold misses)" (put in the top of runbook).

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-345: status -> Mitigated (monitoring) · duration to mitigation: ~7m 20s.

Anya Patel: Handoff summary for next shift: primary: Anya (continuing 45m), secondary: Michael, follow-ups: Devon(TICKET-1789), postmortem owner: Jess.

Michael Chen: Copy — will cover if you step out.

Devon Reyes: Will pick up the scheduler investigation first thing.

oncall-ops-bot: Reminder: please add blameless notes and link to postmortem template: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/template

Anya Patel: Logged. Closing thread for now, will reopen if anything regresses.
